purpose: Correct the V10Y reduced-model start, mass inventory and terminal-state labelling without retuning any declared scenario; expose changes separately before coupling V11A components.
user_target: An initially standing WTC1 model struck by a Boeing767 with documented initial conditions and their uncertainties, then calculated impact damage, fire and structural response, without a prescribed collapse result. WTC2 should reuse engines but retain separate building/event inputs.
unchanged_inputs: all 729 grid scenarios and three named scenarios
floor count 110 and uniform office-story height 3.6576m
full-story resistance, gradient and frozen capacity retention

corrected_law.initial_condition: t=0, downward displacement=0, velocity=0, kinetic energy=0 at the unchanged capacity trigger
corrected_law.initial_interval: At the triggering floor i, traverse d=f*h against F=R_i/h. The work is f*R_i, not the full-story R_i.
corrected_law.mass_split: Keep alpha=0.5 from V10Y independently of gap fraction f. Capture (1-alpha)*floor_mass at the end of the first interval, then floor_mass after each complete subsequent interval i-1..1. This is a lumped bookkeeping convention, not a spatial density reconstruction.
corrected_law.mass_accounts: Cluster mass means mass already assigned/captured, even when velocity is zero. Unaccreted mass remains explicitly tracked. Cluster + unaccreted + deliberately omitted diagnostic mass = 110*floor_mass; corrected V11B has zero omitted mass.
corrected_law.initial_static_condition: If F >= M*g at rest, record capacity trigger but no downward start under the constant-resistance law. Do not inject a velocity, lower resistance or infer real-world non-collapse.
corrected_law.arrest: If kinetic energy is exhausted within or exactly at the interval end, stop with v=0, distance=K_start/(F-M*g), dt=-v_start/a; do not capture mass or add collision loss.
corrected_law.energy: K_initial=0. All gravity work, including the initial interval, is included once. K_final=W_gravity-W_resistance-loss_capture.
corrected_law.terminal_condition: Stop at lower boundary of the uniform 1D stack, with terminal velocity and kinetic energy explicit. Do not call this debris settled or a foundation impact simulation.
corrected_law.post_arrest_policy: Stop at frozen initiation-time resistance. No later heating or restart after arrest is simulated.

variants.status: diagnostic isolates missing initial time; retains missing mass and unsupported initial fall for comparison only
diagnostic isolates initial resistance; retains missing mass for comparison only
corrected reduced-model bookkeeping and start; not a validated structural collapse model

baseline_reference: Replay legacy propagate with cached/rechecked initiation; never write V10Y files or re-run its publishing main.
selection_warning: GRID-0119 is retained because it was previously visualized, not newly selected as the best corrected match. No new chronology optimization.
epistemic_limits: Impact damage and steel temperatures are still official-model-dependent references, not computed from an independently launched aircraft and solved fire.
A capacity trigger and a constant work-per-story resistance are separate hypotheses. Their disagreement is an exposed interface inconsistency, not proof of tower stability.
The uniform 1D stack does not become the mixed-height 3D structure by this bookkeeping correction.
V11A component forces and isolated spring work are not inserted as global collapse resistance.
No new Blender motion, WTC2 model, historical event probability or historical cause verdict is produced.
